verification.scope: Five-PR integration, BIOL157 Units 3–6 and Cell completion batch
verification.summary: 208 combined offline checks and ordinary npm test pass; 40 real Auth/Firestore emulator checks pass with the expanded Bio 222-question bank. Lint/build pass with ten existing warnings and the existing large-entry warning. Chromium traverses all 59 Bio lessons/361 sections and 46 Cell lessons/277 sections at 390px, twelve original figures without clipped labels, Unit 5/6 concept/source/exact-section practice, all eight newer Cell citations and all three full-bank submissions (178/114/222), resume/retry/reload and progress panels. Eleven Bio PDF hashes/page counts and 252 literal anchors verified, plus the Cell 410-page PDF and 123 selected text-page hashes/anchors. No production test or academic sign-off.

deployment.status: Read-only inspection confirms existing Vite project prj_W0ZnmiQ9iO0oyeFPm4HAffXSiheO in the intended team and SSO protection enabled for all deployments. Six Firebase variables are shared across production and preview, with no RC-branch overrides; isolated preview Firebase is not established. No deployment or environment change performed.

blockers: No formal academic sign-off for the final student-visible content.
BIOL157 Units 7–10 not authored; Units 1–6 have substantial source-checked teaching drafts pending academic review.

Cell: all 170 original rationales editorially improved and four review-only question revisions documented; remaining source figures, historical microscopy development, precise concept links, human approval and current-year official scope are unresolved.

Computer: exact manual acceptance steps are prepared but all 15 Microsoft Office desktop scenarios remain unexecuted; four questions withheld; payroll/grading/exactly-40/version ambiguities and 342 unmapped package pages remain open.
Protected preview requires verified existing Vercel project configuration and isolated test Firebase; production rules/auth domains/data separation/rollback not yet verified.
nextCheckpoint: Complete BIOL157 Unit 7 Proteins from all 71 actual Lecture 7 pages and three official outline subtopics, including amino-acid ionisation/calculations, peptide chemistry and protein structure; then Units 8–10 as separate tested batches. Finish Cell source/figure and exact-concept review, Computer remaining supported objectives and Office/manual academic decisions, auditable publication and isolated Firebase/Vercel preview readiness.
